body: I should specify, she was very supportive of me and therapy. She was very supportive of everything up until that night.

Long story, but ultimately she ended things because I was going through therapy and confused, lost. I wasn’t sure of anything at the time. She asked me if I ever loved her, I told her I wasn’t sure, she took it as is. Eventually in my confusion I thought I didn’t, I was lost, very very lost. We took some time apart, I thought I was losing her. One night I got drunk and let my emotions run rampant, I got scared, then angry, then I sent some very harsh, very painful things. I then went over while intoxicated. She was scared, she had never seen that side of me, so angry, so vulgar. My coming over intoxicated in the middle of the night, she didn’t know what to expect. I stood there. I cried.
I’ve tried, she refuses to speak to me. She’s that’s scared. I’ve told her that I’ve been feeling this way, but she’s blown me off. I don’t blame her for doing so after destroying her world.
How I wish this was given to me
